data.title: Arthur Hayes Expects Bitcoin to Hit $126,000 by Year End. Can BTC Climb 46% in Under Three Months?
data.description: BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes calls his latest Bitcoin price target a foregone conclusion, but the math behind getting there before New Year's Eve tells a very different story.
